status_contract.proven: Implemented and directly passed on this frozen artifact.
status_contract.implemented_unverified: Inspectable implementation exists, but this baseline did not run enough proof to promote it.
status_contract.partial: A reusable part exists, but the requirement is not complete on the target Pursuit path.
status_contract.violated: The frozen artifact directly contradicts the requirement.

requirements.requirement: 用户可在 2 秒内创建本地文本 Capture；离线不丢。
evidence: apps/ios/Sources/Services/PendingCaptureInbox.swift atomically persists screenshot assets and drafts
requirements.gap: No two-second text Capture path or measured offline text proof exists.

requirements.requirement: 每个 Source 独立上传、重试、删除，拥有 hash 与 lineage。
evidence: PendingCaptureInbox.swift queues multiple hashed local images and can remove one item
apps/backend/src/modules/captures.ts and deletion-lineage APIs govern backend sources
requirements.gap: Local and backend source state are not one per-source upload/retry/delete state machine.

requirements.requirement: Action Button 使用 App Shortcut Capture Signal，能返回真实状态反馈。
evidence: apps/ios/Sources/App/CaptureAppIntents.swift persists an image and returns a dialog
requirements.gap: The exposed shortcut is Review screenshot rather than the Capture Signal contract, and Action Button execution was not frozen.

requirements.requirement: 录音需要前台时明确切前台；不能录时不显示‘正在录’。
requirements.gap: No audio capture or truthful foreground-recording state was found.

requirements.requirement: Pursuit 有 target outcome、deadline、status、milestone、revision。
requirements.gap: No Pursuit contract, storage, API, or revision exists.

requirements.requirement: Person 与 PursuitRole 分离；同一个人可在多个目标中有不同角色。
evidence: Existing subjects and assignments are relationship-era concepts
requirements.gap: No PursuitRole model proves contextual roles across multiple Pursuits.

requirements.requirement: Gap 必须能指向依据与关闭条件。
requirements.gap: No Gap object, evidence reference, or close condition exists.

requirements.requirement: Action 必须有 owner、状态；需要时有 due date。
evidence: Legacy action_proposals model execution authority, not Pursuit work ownership
requirements.gap: No canonical Pursuit action with accountable owner and optional due date exists.

requirements.requirement: 招聘与销售模板共享 schema，模板字段不得污染通用内核。
requirements.gap: Neither the shared Pursuit schema nor recruiting and sales contract fixtures exist.

requirements.requirement: 每个 confirmed Claim 至少一个 Evidence ref 或明确的 user-authored attribution。
evidence: apps/backend/src/modules/proposals.ts requires exact active evidence for proposed assertions
requirements.gap: There is no invariant covering every confirmed Claim or an explicit user-authored attribution alternative.

requirements.requirement: Fact / inference / unknown / disputed / superseded 可区分。
evidence: Existing assertion and knowledge states distinguish proposed, ambiguous, contested, confirmed, superseded, and expired cases
requirements.gap: The target Claim contract does not explicitly and consistently encode all five epistemic states.

requirements.requirement: 同名身份不自动 merge；模糊项进入 identity review。
evidence: packages/contracts/src/schemas.ts CaptureIdentitySchema
apps/backend/src/modules/identityResolution.ts
apps/backend/src/resourceContracts.test.ts duplicate and identity-review cases
requirements.gap: The baseline full iOS check failed before this could be promoted as target-path proof.

requirements.requirement: Source 删除会传播到派生 Claim 和 projection。
evidence: apps/backend/src/modules/captures.ts deletion propagation
apps/backend/src/evaluation/runResourceDeletionEvaluation.ts
apps/backend/src/evaluation/runRetentionEvaluation.ts
requirements.gap: Existing lineage uses relationship-era assertions/projections and was not rerun on this frozen baseline.

requirements.requirement: Agent 只通过 allowlisted typed tools 读取 / Stage。
evidence: Backend endpoints are typed, but no bounded Agent runtime invokes an allowlist
requirements.gap: No Agent SDK tool boundary exists.

requirements.requirement: Structured output 必须通过 schema，否则不得创建可确认 Proposal。
evidence: TypeBox validates SubmitAnalysisProposalRequestSchema and proposals.ts adds semantic guards
requirements.gap: No Agent structured-output adapter or invalid-output quarantine path exists.

requirements.requirement: SDK session 不是 canonical memory；run 可由 Backend snapshot 重建。
evidence: apps/backend/src/modules/chat.ts loads a knowledge snapshot and records a context manifest
requirements.gap: No SDK session/run implementation demonstrates reconstruction from the snapshot.

requirements.requirement: 每次 run 记录 model / prompt / tool / SDK / policy fingerprint 与 budget。
evidence: Context manifests record a policy version only
requirements.gap: No run record contains the complete fingerprint and budget receipt.

requirements.requirement: V1 不存在自动外部发送工具。
evidence: Existing action capability is explicitly simulated
iOS copy and tests state that no message, meeting, contact, ATS record, or reminder is created
requirements.gap: A release binary and Agent tool-manifest audit has not yet proved the final V1 surface.

requirements.requirement: Review 展示 source、identity、before、proposed、reason、effect。
evidence: RelationshipArchiveSheets.swift shows evidence/provenance and before/proposed state
requirements.gap: Full identity correction, reason, effect, and Pursuit association are not all visible together.

requirements.requirement: 用户可逐项 confirm / edit / reject / keep unresolved。
evidence: CandidateSignal review supports per-fact confirm, edit, and dismiss
requirements.gap: The frozen relationship review offers only whole-package confirm or unresolved, and no target-path item receipt is proven.

requirements.requirement: stale revision 返回 conflict，不静默覆盖。
evidence: apps/backend/src/modules/actions.ts rejects expected_action_version conflicts
requirements.gap: The relationship confirmation has no revision or conflict path.

requirements.requirement: response loss 进入 unknown locked 并对账，不能重复提交。
evidence: apps/backend/src/modules/actions.ts records unknown effect attempts and requires reconcileEffect before retry
requirements.gap: The frozen review confirmation is local state and cannot become unknown, locked, or reconciled.

requirements.requirement: Receipt 是结构化事实，不只是一句 Toast。
evidence: Backend capture/action APIs return structured receipts
requirements.gap: The frozen relationship review renders a sentence from local @State with no structured canonical receipt.

requirements.requirement: 所有读写、缓存、队列和 Agent run 强制 workspace scope。
evidence: Backend tables, foreign keys, and module queries consistently carry account_id
requirements.gap: The local capture directory is not workspace-scoped and no Agent run scope exists.

requirements.requirement: Imported content 不可改变工具权限或系统指令。
evidence: apps/backend/src/modules/research.test.ts and researchProjection.test.ts keep injection-like text as inert evidence
requirements.gap: No real bounded Agent run proves tool-policy immutability across all imported source types.

requirements.requirement: 12 条 P0 journey 有 deterministic final-state oracle。
evidence: Existing tests cover several legacy scenarios
requirements.gap: There is no manifest and oracle set for the twelve Notion V2 P0 journeys.

requirements.requirement: Agent critical cases 使用 Claude Agent SDK multi-trial runner。
requirements.gap: No Claude Agent SDK or multi-trial critical-case runner exists.

requirements.requirement: Release 不包含 AutomationBridge、mock endpoint 或 test token。
evidence: apps/ios/Sources/App/TalentSignalApp.swift includes production ProcessInfo launch-argument routing for --endpoint, --fixture-id, and deterministic scenarios
The frozen Release build compiles the same source
requirements.gap: Test-only routing is not excluded from Release.

requirements.requirement: 375×667、AX5、VoiceOver 可完成 Capture 与 Review。
evidence: CandidateSignalUITests.swift contains an AX5 dark-mode path
Round-4 evidence previously passed touch and AX5 on a larger simulator
requirements.gap: The Pursuit path lacks 375x667 proof and direct VoiceOver completion; the frozen iOS run is not green.
